node.statement: The associator axiom gives ||u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h)-(u^dagger bold-dot u) bold-dot h||<=e||u||^2||h||<8*e; since u^dagger bold-dot u=J and left multiplication by h has norm below (1+e)||h||<3, the resulting outer error is below 24*e. Thus the total is below 44*e.
